reason: The workshop needs to be easy to find, and bright paint looks suited to marking its front.
expectation: The paint will make the workshop front more visible.

effect: The paint has no available combination, so marking the front that way is not currently possible.
reaction: That was an unexpected dead end.
reason: The retired address display may give the workshop a visible location.
expectation: The display will be installed or adapted to identify the workshop.

alternatives.reason: Checking the front's available partners could clarify how to make it findable.

effect: The address display is now configured with the local address and request-desk call button; it may be ready to identify the workshop.
reaction: The automatic setup was a useful surprise.
reason: The configured display should help people find and contact the workshop from its front.
expectation: The display will be installed at the workshop front.

effect: The configured display cannot currently be combined with anything, so I don't yet know how it contributes to opening the workshop.
reaction: That was another unexpected dead end.
reason: Inspecting the workshop front should reveal what can actually be done with it.
expectation: The inspection will identify available partners for preparing the workshop front.

effect: Sal's fob opened the shutter and made the stocked workshop accessible.
reaction: The automatic opening clarified the next stage.
reason: The bright paint may now be useful for marking the opened workshop.
expectation: The paint will add a visible workshop sign or marking.

alternatives.reason: I could check its available partners first.

effect: The open workshop now has a freshly painted sign identifying it.
reaction: Sal's addition to the sign was a nice touch.
reason: The remaining goal of giving the night shift a reason to linger suggests putting the breakfast noodles in Sal's hot broth.
expectation: The noodles and broth will make a meal for the shift.

effect: The noodles and broth became breakfast, completing the night-shift goal.
reaction: It's satisfying to see the shift get a proper break.
reason: The local audio receiver looks like a suitable way to connect Miro's working speaker to the local network.
expectation: The receiver will connect to the speaker for local audio.

alternatives.reason: I could check what remains to open the workshop.

effect: The receiver is tuned to Tin Row through a separate public-audio channel; it has not yet been connected to the speaker.
reaction: The separate channel is a useful detail, though the attempted pairing took an unexpected route.
reason: The tuned receiver and working speaker now seem ready to play Tin Row's broadcast.
expectation: The speaker will play the broadcast received from Tin Row.

effect: The speaker now plays Tin Row's broadcast; the workshop-opening goal remains.
reaction: Reusing the repaired speaker is a nice callback.
reason: Inspecting the freshly lettered workshop should clarify what remains to open it for use.
expectation: The inspection will reveal any available next step for the workshop.

effect: The inspection automatically installed the local delivery display, opening the workshop and completing the final goal.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the address display finally help someone find the bench.

mostWorthwhile.text: Opening the workshop with the local display brought the repair and address problems together in a concrete result: a rider could find a bench the neighborhood can maintain.

leastWorthwhile.text: The early attempts to mark the front and install the display were frustrating dead ends; the required order was not yet clear.

surprise.text: Trying the display against the front instead automatically configured it through the controller; later, inspecting the lettered workshop finally installed it.

arbitrary.text: The paint having no available operation before the shutter was opened felt unintuitive, even though it worked afterward.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter to see how the workshop and its neighbors use the network, although the early dead ends made this chapter's ordering less satisfying.
